about: Art the Exile theme requests and the steel/masonry kit does not have (docs/crafting-helper/design/ASSET-REQUESTS.md). Drop each file here under its listed name, set the entry's status to delivered, and rebuild: src/requested-art.ts finds it and the Exile rules in src/steel.css draw it in place of the placeholder.

requests.element: trade/TradePanel.svelte: the Match group's two radio buttons, input[type='radio'] in .choice
craft/ItemPanel.svelte: the grabbed item's card, section.item-panel
craft/RoutePreview.svelte: the route's step number plate, ol.steps .number
App.svelte: the header Settings button's update-available mark, .update-mark .dot
